name: infrastructure-ci-openspec
description: Pins the OpenSpec CLI that pr-validation.yml uses to validate this repository's own specification record. This repository has no JavaScript; the manifest exists because Dependabot's npm ecosystem reads package.json and cannot see a version pinned inline in a workflow step, and four exactly-pinned manifests here already go unwatched. The package is @fission-ai/openspec; the binary it installs is openspec.
